title: Binary attachments in forwarded forms, whk 1.20.4, SDK 1.34.0 and MCP 2.6.2
items: A destination that forwards email in the SendGrid Inbound Parse or Mailgun route shape now carries every inline attachment as a file part with its exact bytes, a PDF or an image as much as a CSV, as those providers post them; before, binary files were left out of the form. The Standard Webhooks signature covers the exact bytes, so check it against the raw body: a handler that checks it against the body read as text keeps working for text-only mail but now fails on mail with a binary file

The changelog lists whk 1.20.4, whose `deliveries summary --destination` counts one destination and whose tunnel posts the same forms with their binary files, and SDK 1.34.0, whose `verifyStandardWebhookSignature()` checks such a form over its raw bytes, and MCP 2.6.2, whose `verify_signature` does the same for a captured form
